frontmatter.name: photo-forensics
frontmatter.description: Use for any photo check — EXIF time/GPS plausibility, SHA-256, CLIP embeddings (transformers.js on CPU), near-duplicate detection and the AI-generated-image risk from lib/ai.

frontmatter.name: disaster-feeds
frontmatter.description: Use for the location signal — GDACS and USGS event feeds, event areas (polygon or radius), point-in-area tests, the simulated demo event, feed caching and the far-from-any-event hard rule.

frontmatter.name: solana-trail
frontmatter.description: Use for the public Solana devnet trail — queueing donation/decision/payout records, the Token-2022 test-PYUSD + Memo transaction, retries without duplicates, explorer links, faucets, and never putting PII on chain.

frontmatter.name: render-workflows
frontmatter.description: Use for background steps and deploys — Render Workflows tasks (verify_claim with parallel checks, send_payout, release_waiting_funds), triggering them from API routes, local dev, the inline fallback and the render.yaml Blueprint.

nodes.label: decide() decision order
